record.paper_title: Reusing Space: Techniques and Open Problems
record.original_question: Can one prove that the threshold-circuit class TC1 is contained in the arithmetic-circuit class VP?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Define the following complexity classes.

(1) TC^1: the class of Boolean languages decided by a non-uniform family of Boolean circuits {C_n} of polynomial size and O(log n) depth, with gates of unbounded fan-in computing AND, OR, NOT, and MAJORITY (threshold) functions.

(2) VP (Valiant's class P): the class of families of multivariate polynomials (f_n) over a field (say ℚ, or any fixed field) such that f_n has polynomially bounded degree in n and is computed by an arithmetic circuit of polynomial size in n using +, ×, and field constants, with inputs being variables or constants.

A Boolean class C is said to be contained in VP if there is a polynomial-size projection / appropriate reduction sending each language L ∈ C to a polynomial family in VP whose coefficients encode membership in L (formally: for every language L ∈ TC^1 there exists a polynomial family (f_n) ∈ VP and a polynomial-time–computable projection from inputs x of length n to monomials/variable settings such that f_n evaluated at this setting equals 1 if x ∈ L and 0 otherwise).

Problem: Prove or disprove that TC^1 ⊆ VP.
artifact.status_search_result: The containment of TC^1 in VP is a known open problem in algebraic and circuit complexity. Existing literature characterizes TC^1 via dual-VP-style arithmetic classes (Agrawal–Allender and follow-ups), but no proof of TC^1 ⊆ VP has been established as of available sources.

status_evidence.title: On TC0, AC0, and Arithmetic Circuits
status_evidence.snippet: Dual-VP arithmetic classes provide characterizations of ACC^1 and TC^1, indicating the relationship between threshold and arithmetic classes is still being explored.
status_evidence.claim: Connections between TC^1 and arithmetic (VP-style) classes remain a subject of ongoing characterization rather than a resolved containment.

status_evidence.title: Arithmetic Constant-Depth Circuit Complexity Classes
status_evidence.snippet: Arithmetic complexity classes dual to VP(F_p) give new characterizations of ACC^1 and TC^1.
status_evidence.claim: TC^1 is studied via dual-VP characterizations, suggesting TC^1 ⊆ VP is not known.
